messages:
Tara (prod): Heads up: published the new 'On-Prem Data Submission Policy' in the KB. It standardizes what telemetry and diagnostic payloads our agents will send by default for Private/VPC installs and adds an explicit operator opt-out. Please read before next week's partner sync: https://internal.kb/redwood/onprem-data-submission-policy

Vik (eng-platform): TL;DR: default behavior remains to send anonymized metrics + error traces. New opt-out flag `telemetry.submission: disabled` prevents any non-essential payloads (no prompts, no responses). We included a sample values.yaml and migration notes.

Nate (customer-success): Request: can we get a short customer-facing blurb and a checkbox copy for onboarding screens? Some prospects want to opt-out during onboarding.

Amira (legal): Reviewed. Need to call out retention windows by region and add explicit language about law enforcement/complaint exceptions. I left suggested edits in the KB. Do not publish externally until I sign off on the EU wording.

ops-bot: KB draft posted: /kb/onprem-data-submission-policy-2026-05-10  reviewers requested: eng-platform, security, legal, customer-success

Vik (eng-platform): Implementation snippet (values.yaml):
```
telemetry:
  submission: enabled   # options: enabled | disabled | prompt
  retention_days: 30
```

Vik (eng-platform): When `submission: prompt` the agent will delay non-essential uploads until the operator acknowledges via the local UI or the `/telemetry/consent` API. Agent v3+ supports this flag; no forced upgrade.

Amira (legal): Also: add a short paragraph about customer control for SOC2/ISO customers who want an attestation that we never access logs without written permission. I'll provide wording tomorrow.

Nate (customer-success): I'll draft a one-pager and a short email for pilots. Scheduling two office hours to gather pilot feedback (Mon 9am PT, Thu 4pm PT). Will post invites to #customer-success.

Tara (prod): Action items: (1) @Amira finalize EU/legal wording by Tue EOD, (2) @Vik add the `/telemetry/submission/status` healthcheck + sample curl, (3) @Nate prepare CS one-pager. Please react with :white_check_mark: when done.

Vik (eng-platform): Adding the healthcheck now. Sample curl in KB: `curl -sS http://agent.local/telemetry/submission/status | jq`

Amira (legal): Acked. Will post final wording by Tue.

Nate (customer-success): Acked. I'll coordinate pilot invites and the customer blurb.
